ride.name: Shared ride (rideshare)
ride.desc: Your craft travels with dozens of others. Very cheap (~6,500 $/kg), but you go to the main customer's orbit on their date.
ride.simplified: The price is rounded from the published rideshare price [S-rideshare-price]; the capacity to each orbit is our own estimate for the game (that source gives prices, not capacities), and so are the failure and delay chances.

light.desc: A small dedicated rocket. You pick the orbit and the date.
light.simplified: Capacity to each orbit and the price are rounded from the published figures; the failure and delay chances are our own estimate of each class.
